items.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13
items.q: Buster was on the trombone, I was on the drum. ... And I made a record with the harmonica.

ctx.x: Who else played on that? Anybody else or just you? You see, Mac Neal was playing that night.

Who? Mac Neal, a friend named Ernest Rubio, and I liked the guitar. Buster was on the trombone, I was on the drum. Yeah? You know that four people? And I made a record with the harmonica. Huh? It was at a party.
Buster was playing. Oh, at a party, huh? Yeah. That never was issued, I mean, it never came out like on a record.
